title: Dhammapada Verses
credit: Pāḷi text and English translation as in Mor’s Pāḷi Workshop booklet.

paras.en:
People go to many places for refuge —
to mountains and forests,
parks and tree shrines,
when they are startled by fear.

This is not a safe refuge,
this is not the highest refuge.
Not by going to this refuge
is one liberated from all dukkha.

But one who has gone for refuge to the Buddha,
the Dhamma and the Saṅgha,
who sees the Four Noble Truths
with perfect wisdom —

dukkha, the origination of dukkha,
the going beyond of dukkha,
and the Noble Eightfold Path
leading to the cessation of dukkha.

This indeed is the safe refuge,
this is the highest refuge.
Having gone to this refuge,
one is liberated from all dukkha.
